Workflow Challenges: > They previously used CIQ Legacy screening but now have CIQ Pro, and they are unable to find similar criteria. > They would also like to include the definitions in terms of transaction values. > The client also mentioned that, in terms of aggregates, CIQ Legacy has more client‑friendly features.
Solutions Discussed: Screening Steps I have created a Transaction screen for you titled "Buy-Side M&A Fees." To navigate this, please follow the steps below: 1. In the top-right corner of the CIQ Pro platform, click the Screener. 2. At the bottom of Key Workflows, select Manage Screens > Click on the mentioned saved screen. 3. Click on Run Screen to view results. I have also showed the client how to navigate the Transaction screener. Here are the steps in replicating the screen for your reference: 1. In the top navigation bar, click on Screener > Select Transactions. 2. In the left handlings, click on Browse Criteria. 3. Search for the keyfield: IQ_INDUSTRY_CLASSIFICATION > In: Energy and Industrials > Applies to: Target/Issuer > Add. 4. Search for the keyfield: SPTR_TRANSACTION_VALUE > Between: 0 - 3000 > Add. 5. Search for the keyfield: SPTR_CLOSED_DATE > Set the timeframe. 6. Search for the keyfield: SPTR_ADVISER_FEE > Greater than: 0 > Adviser Role: Financial Advisory > Party Advised: Buyer/Investor > Add > Done. Aggregates To show the aggregates, you can click "Options" > Show Statistics to display the minimum, average, median, maximum, and standard deviation and/or Group by any category you wish. I’ve noted your feedback regarding the aggregates on CIQ Pro, which differ from those on CIQ Legacy. I apologize for this limitation on our end. Please note that prior to this email, I have sent an Enhancement Request to our Product Management so they can review this further and hopefully consider adding this to our future releases. Thank you for understanding! Currency and Magnitude You can change the currency at the top part of the screener. Alternatively, currency and magnitude can be changed by clicking on the Settings. Criteria vs Display Columns Criteria will filter the results, so only records that meet these criteria will be included and anything that does not meet them will be filtered out. Display columns control which columns are shown, regardless of whether they contain data, and they do not affect the number of results returned. Transaction Value vs Total Transaction Value vs Deal Value You may find the definition of the criteria in the screener. For the mentioned keyfields, here are the differences: Transaction Value [KeyField: 300198, SPTR_DEAL_TRANSACTION_VALUE] Deal value paid for equity, plus the value of assumed current liabilities, net of current assets Total Transaction Value [KeyField: 300057, SPTR_TRANSACTION_VALUE] For M&A, this is the consideration accrued to the seller for all target securities, including assumed liabilities. For capital offerings, this is the principal amount of capital raised in the offering, before fees and other expenses, including any amounts not sold directly by the issuer and exercised overallotment options. For rounds of funding and private M&A deals, this will also include estimated values (e.g. values disclosed by sources close to the matter reported in news or press or rumored values). For equity buybacks, this is the price paid for equity repurchased by company. For spin-offs or split-offs, this is the distribution value of target equity distributed to the seller’s shareholders.​​​​​​​ Deal Value [KeyField: 300194, SPTR_DEAL_VALUE] Total consideration accrued to the sellers. Includes only the price paid for equity, not assumption of any obligations of the entity sold. For Spin-off/ Split-offs, this field indicates distribution value of the transaction.
